notes.title: Demo Bug Fixing _ Sep 17 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p][/p][p]We fixed the following bugs in this update --[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed the bug where the drop rate of Fragrant Grease was abnormally low.
Fixed the bug that allowed Biting Mimic to repeatedly deduct health when rapidly interacted with.
Fixed the bug where Explosive Doll would not explode when inside a Hook Guard's bag.
Fixed the bug that allowed pre-order customers to incorrectly receive products.
Fixed the bug where moving a Strong Bone Shard would cause a loss of health.
Fixed the bug where clicking on items could accidentally trigger drag-and-drop actions.
Fixed the bug where pressing ESC during the loading screen would cause the game to freeze.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your feedback and support![/p]

notes.title: Quick Bug Fixing _ Sep 12, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Here’s a quick patch update—[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where some dialogue fonts displayed incorrectly;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Boss’s inventory was still empty in certain situations;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the Boss HUD displaying at the wrong layer;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some doors in levels saved incorrectly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to all players for your feedback and comments![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update & Bug Fixing _ Sep 10 2025
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, we --[/p][p][/p][p]Added new item: Fragrant Grease (enchanting an item with it can temporarily increase the customer’s Deal Range);[/p][p align="justify"]Added new item: Smoking Doll (placing it into an enemy’s backpack continuously releases smoke);[/p][p][/p][p]Remade the employee recruitment process;[/p][p align="justify"]Updated parts of the UI;[/p][p align="justify"]Adjusted base item values;[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed the bug where grease occasionally could not be used;[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the bug where the Boss could not move after revival;[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the bug where the Boss’s backpack was empty under certain circumstances;[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the bug where the interface became disordered after the shop reached level 5;[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the bug where the bottom of the warehouse was blocked by other pages;[/p][p][/p][p]We will keep updating this demo while spending most of our time working on the rest of the game.[/p][p]Thank you again for your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update & Bugs Fixing _ Aug 4 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions.
This update includes the following fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where NPC backpack contents would become scrambled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Explosive Doll could detonate inside the player's backpack under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Strong Bone Shard would occasionally reduce HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items accidentally clicked during a canceled trade would disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Invisibility Potions could revive fallen adventurers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could wall-jump into the second area using an unintended method.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the Blind Skeleton's sleep animation.[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll continue working to fix other bugs—thank you all for your support![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update and Bugs Fixing _ Jul 30 2025
notes.notes: [p][b]Thank you to all players for your feedback and suggestions.[/b][/p][h3][b]This update does not include major new content. The focus was on bug fixes, UI improvements, and numerical adjustments. Key changes are as follows:[/b][/h3][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p]● Fixed a bug where the map failed to display after reaching Goldville.[/p][p]● Fixed occasional crashes related to Collections and Charms.[/p][p]● Fixed the unusable Silent Potion bug.[/p][p]● Fixed overlapping effects for Bone Shards.[/p][p]● Fixed Bone Shards not shattering upon player death.[/p][p]● Fixed the unusable Grease item during trades.[/p][p]● Fixed accidental item dragging when clicking items.[/p][p]● Fixed the Biting Chest failing to kill targets.[/p][p]● Fixed interface freezes when opening inventory while dying.[/p][p]● Fixed incorrect bonus values for Prismatic Gems.[/p][p]● Fixed various other UI-related bugs.[/p][h3][b]Numerical Adjustments:[/b][/h3][p]● Rebalanced shop upgrade values.[/p][p]● Increased pre-order multipliers.[/p][p]● Boosted quest multipliers for Aliya’s missions.[/p][p]● Shops no longer automatically gain more customers upon upgrades ([i]a franchise system will be introduced later to assist with sales[/i]).[/p][h3][b]System & UI:[/b][/h3][p]● Added automatic nightly saves (game now saves at the start of [i]both morning and evening[/i] each day).[/p][p]● Added volume adjustment and exit buttons.[/p][p]● Optimized select UI layouts for clarity and readability.[/p]
